title: Readonly Cosmetic Mutation Guard
acceptance: All six cosmetic/purchase remotes reject readonly profiles including loss of lock after successful load; no debit, grant, selection, claim or placement changes and no success notification.
A clear retry/refusal reaches the UI; forged remote calls cannot bypass it; explicitly isolated memory-only Studio mode remains usable with its unsaved banner.

Behavior tests cover loading, saved, memory, newer-schema readonly and lock-loss readonly; define scope for existing EconomyService consistently with project policy; check.sh and a 2-client test pass.
